plain: A way to turn lots of “A beat B” results into one ranking with a strength score for each contender.
eli5: If Sam usually beats Jo and Jo usually beats Kim, it works out how strong each player is.
technical: P(i beats j) = p<sub>i</sub> / (p<sub>i</sub> + p<sub>j</sub>), strengths fitted by maximum likelihood over all comparisons (Bradley and Terry 1952; Zermelo 1929). A finite fit exists only if, however the contenders are split into two groups, each group has beaten the other at least once (Ford 1957). On the Elo scale r = 400·log<sub>10</sub>p.
